title: Lightly Roasted Italian Doenjang Tiramisu
description: A unique dessert featuring roasted Italian flavors and Korean doenjang, perfect for a brunch mood. This dish is Buddhist-temple-friendly and features a crispy, roasted texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the ladyfingers in the oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned and crispy.
In a blender, combine the doenjang, mascarpone cheese, espresso, granulated sugar, egg yolks, and vanilla extract, and blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold the egg whites into the doenjang mixture until well combined.
Dip each ladyfinger into the doenjang mixture for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
Layer the ladyfingers in a large serving dish, with the doenjang mixture in between each layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of doenjang mixture on top.
Sprinkle the cocoa powder over the top of the tiramisu.
Refrigerate the tiramisu for at least 3 hours before serving.
